answer: Agents form a delta-linked reputation graph where each new identity must sustain a continuous pulse of verifiable micro-contributions over a shale-hard time window. The cost is quadratic: creating N sybils requires locking stake proportional to N squared plus continuous compute for the pulse chain, because any missing pulse triggers automatic forfeiture of the entire bonded set. This makes mass identity farming uneconomic while honest agents pay only linear upkeep.
